description: A sprite sheet of EIGHT separate game UI pieces arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell. Top row: four tall empty rectangular card frames with an empty hollow magenta center: a plain grey stone card frame, a blue silver card frame with small gems, a purple ornate card frame with violet crystals, a radiant golden card frame with a tiny crown on top and sparkles. Bottom row: four small round rarity badges matching the cards: a grey badge with one star, a blue badge with two stars, a purple badge with three stars, a golden badge with four stars. Front view, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every piece fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, card centers empty magenta, no text, no numbers, no characters, no animals
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
